en.t: Maya king Yuknoom Yich'aak K'ahk' assumes the crown of Calakmul
en.s: Yuknoom Yichʼaak Kʼahkʼ () or Yuknoom Ixquiac (lit. 'Jaguar Paw Smoke'; October 6, 649 – December 15, 697) was a Maya king of the Kaan kingdom, which had its capital at Calakmul during the Classic Period of Mesoamerican chronology.

zh.t: 玛雅国王尤克努姆·伊奇阿克·卡克登上卡拉克穆尔王位
zh.s: 尤克努姆·伊奇阿克·卡克（Yuknoom Yichʼaak Kʼahkʼ），又称Yuknoom Ixquiac（字面意为“美洲豹之爪烟雾”；649年10月6日—697年12月15日），是玛雅卡安王国的国王。古典时期，该王国的首都设在卡拉克穆尔。

en.t: Polyeuctus of Constantinople is elected as patriarch of Constantinople
en.s: Polyeuctus of Constantinople (Greek: Πολύευκτος; died 5 February 970) was Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople (956–970). His orthodox feast is on 5 February.

zh.t: 波利埃夫克特出任君士坦丁堡牧首
zh.s: 956年4月3日，波利埃夫克特开始担任君士坦丁堡普世牧首。

en.t: Edward the Confessor is crowned King of England
en.s: Edward the Confessor (1003/1005 – 5 January 1066) was King of the English from 1042 until his death in 1066. He was the last reigning monarch of the House of Wessex. Edward was the son of Æthelred the Unready and Emma of Normandy. He succeeded Cnut the Great's son – and his own half-brother – Harthacnut.

zh.t: 忏悔者爱德华加冕为英格兰国王
zh.s: 1043年4月3日，忏悔者爱德华在温彻斯特大教堂加冕为英格兰国王。

en.s: The Battle of Florvåg (Norwegian: Slaget ved Florvåg) was a naval battle that was fought on 3 April 1194 between King Sverre Sigurdsson, leader of the Birkebeiner party, and Sigurd Magnusson, the Eyjarskeggjar party pretender. Although there had been previous revolts during Sverre's reign following his usurpation of the throne in 1184, the revolt in support of Sigurd Magnusson (son of former king Magnus Erlingsson) became far more threatening than the attempts of previous pretenders.

zh.s: 弗洛尔沃格海战（挪威语：Slaget ved Florvåg）于1194年4月3日爆发，交战双方是比尔克拜纳党领袖、国王斯韦雷·西居尔松，以及厄亚尔斯凯格尔党王位觊觎者西居尔·马格努松。斯韦雷于1184年篡位后，曾发生过几次叛乱；但这次支持前国王马格努斯·埃林松之子西居尔·马格努松的叛乱，对斯韦雷的威胁远大于此前其他觊觎王位者发动的叛乱。

en.s: The Battle of Nájera, also known as the Battle of Navarrete, was fought on 3 April 1367 near Nájera, in the province of La Rioja, Castile. It was an episode of the first Castilian Civil War which confronted King Peter of Castile with his half-brother Count Henry of Trastámara who aspired to the throne involving Castile in the international conflict of the Hundred Years' War. The Castilian naval power - far superior to that of France or England - would encourage these two Nations involved in the Hundred Years' War to take sides in the Castilian Civil War with the purpose of having the Castilian fleet at their disposal.

zh.s: 1367年4月3日，卡斯蒂利亚拉里奥哈省纳赫拉附近爆发战役，又称纳瓦雷特战役。这是第一次卡斯蒂利亚内战的一部分：国王佩德罗与觊觎王位的异母兄弟、特拉斯塔马拉伯爵恩里克争夺统治权，使卡斯蒂利亚卷入百年战争的国际冲突。卡斯蒂利亚海军实力远强于法国和英格兰，因此百年战争中的这两国都选择介入内战，意图争取卡斯蒂利亚舰队为己所用。

en.t: Henry II of France and Philip II of Spain signed the second treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis, ending the Italian War of 1551–1559
en.s: The Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis in April 1559 ended the Italian Wars (1494–1559). It consisted of two separate treaties, one between England and France on 2 April, and another between France and Spain on 3 April. Although he was not a signatory, both were approved by Emperor Ferdinand I, since many of the territorial exchanges concerned states within the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.t: 法国亨利二世与西班牙腓力二世签署第二份卡托-康布雷齐条约，结束1551—1559年意大利战争
zh.s: 1559年4月的卡托-康布雷齐条约结束了1494年至1559年的意大利战争。条约由两份分别签署的协定组成：英格兰与法国于4月2日签署一份，法国与西班牙于4月3日签署另一份。虽然皇帝斐迪南一世并非签署方，但由于多项领土交换涉及神圣罗马帝国境内的邦国，两份条约都经他批准。

en.s: The Battle of Camp Hill (or the Battle of Birmingham) took place in and around Camp Hill, during the First English Civil War, on Easter Monday, 3 April 1643, when a company of Parliamentarians from the Lichfield garrison with the support of some of the local townsmen, in all about 300 men, attempted to stop a detachment of Royalists, of about 1,200 cavalry and dragoons and 600 to 700 foot, under the command of Prince Rupert from passing through the unfortified parliamentary town of Birmingham.

zh.s: 1643年4月3日复活节星期一，第一次英国内战期间，双方在坎普希尔及周边交战，此役也称伯明翰战役。一支来自利奇菲尔德驻军的议会军连队，在部分当地居民支持下，共约300人，试图阻止鲁珀特亲王率领的保王党分遣队穿过伯明翰。伯明翰当时由议会派控制，尚未设防；保王党则有约1200名骑兵和龙骑兵，以及600至700名步兵。

en.t: Robert Walpole becomes, in effect, the first Prime Minister of Great Britain, though he himself denied that title
en.s: Robert Walpole, 1st Earl of Orford (; 26 August 1676 – 18 March 1745), known between 1725 and 1742 as Sir Robert Walpole, was a British Whig statesman who is generally regarded as the de facto first Prime Minister of Great Britain, serving from 1721 to 1742. His formal titles included First Lord of the Treasury, Chancellor of the Exchequer, and Leader of the House of Commons.

zh.t: 罗伯特·沃波尔开始主持英国政府
zh.s: 1721年4月3日，罗伯特·沃波尔开始出任英国财政大臣，后来被视为英国第一位事实上的首相。

en.s: The siege of Fort William took place in the Scottish Highlands during the 1745 Jacobite Rising, from 20 March to 3 April 1746. On 1 February 1746, the Jacobites abandoned the siege of Stirling Castle and withdrew to Inverness to wait for spring. This period was used to reduce government strongpoints in the Highlands, including Blair Castle and Fort Augustus; after its surrender on 1 March, they moved onto Fort William.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 威廉堡围城战发生在苏格兰高地，时间为1745年詹姆斯党起义期间的1746年3月20日至4月3日。1746年2月1日，詹姆斯党人放弃围攻斯特灵城堡，撤至因弗内斯等待春季到来。他们利用这段时间削弱高地的政府军据点，包括布莱尔城堡和奥古斯都堡。奥古斯都堡于3月1日投降后，他们转而进攻威廉堡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Lahore was battle which took place between the invading Ahmed Shah Abdali and Mir Mannu, the Mughal governor of Punjab in 1752. It took place at Lahore in current day Punjab province of Pakistan. After the Mughals were defeated, Abdali decided to retain Mannu as the city's governor on his own behalf.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1752年，入侵者艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜兰尼与莫卧儿帝国旁遮普总督米尔·曼努之间爆发拉合尔之战。战斗发生在今巴基斯坦旁遮普省的拉合尔。莫卧儿军队战败后，杜兰尼决定让曼努继续担任该城总督，代表自己治理。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1776 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was the first election in the State after its secession from British colonies and joining the United States. The election was organized for April 3, 1776, when Nicholas Cooke won unopposed with 100% of the vote. Cooke had also governed the State when it was a Colony.

zh.s: 1776年4月3日举行的罗得岛州州长选举，是该州脱离英国殖民地并加入美国后的首次选举。尼古拉斯·库克在没有对手的情况下获得100%选票，当选州长。罗得岛仍是殖民地时，库克也曾治理该地。

en.s: The 1782 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1782, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Independent governor William Greene won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1782年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。独立派现任州长威廉·格林因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Massachusetts on April 3, 1786. James Bowdoin, the incumbent governor, defeated John Hancock, the president of the Confederation Congress.

zh.s: 1786年4月3日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长詹姆斯·鲍登击败邦联国会主席约翰·汉考克。

en.s: The Siege of Darwar was a 29 week siege of the fort at Dharwad in 1790 and 1791, then near the frontier, between the Kingdom of Mysore and the Maratha Empire. The Marathas, assisted by forces of the British East India Company, began the siege on 18 September 1790 and resulted with the surrender of the Mysorean garrison on 3 April 1791.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 达瓦尔围城战是1790年至1791年迈索尔王国与马拉塔帝国之间持续29周的一场围城战，当时该堡垒位于边境附近。马拉塔军在英国东印度公司的协助下于1790年9月18日开始围城，迈索尔守军于1791年4月3日投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1792 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1792, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland, following the death of Governor George Plater in office. Federalist candidate and former Governor Thomas Sim Lee was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against other candidates to complete the term of late Governor Plater, before winning a full term in his own right on November 12, 1792.

zh.s: 1792年4月3日，马里兰州因州长乔治·普莱特任内去世而举行州长选举。州议会选出联邦党候选人、前州长托马斯·西姆·李，击败其他候选人，完成普莱特的剩余任期。李后来又于1792年11月12日赢得一个完整任期。

en.s: The 1793 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1793, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Anti-Federalist governor Arthur Fenner won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1793年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。反联邦党现任州长阿瑟·芬纳因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: The 1797 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 3. Incumbent Governor Samuel Adams did not stand for election to a fourth term. The party system was still taking shape in the state, and the Federalists nominated Increase Sumner, while more populist factions that had previously supported Governors John Hancock and Samuel Adams nominated Moses Gill and James Sullivan, respectively.

zh.s: 1797年4月3日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。现任州长塞缪尔·亚当斯没有寻求连任第四个任期。该州的政党制度仍在形成中，联邦党提名英克里斯·萨姆纳；此前支持约翰·汉考克州长和塞缪尔·亚当斯州长的民粹派则分别提名摩西·吉尔和詹姆斯·沙利文。

en.s: The 1799 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1799, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Arthur Fenner won re-election as he ran unopposed. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1799年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主共和党现任州长阿瑟·芬纳因无竞争对手而连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.t: April 1800 United States Senate special election in New York
en.s: The first 1800 United States Senate special election in New York was held on April 3, 1800, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1800年4月纽约州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1800年4月3日，纽约州议会举行该年第一次联邦参议员特别选举，选出代表本州的第一组联邦参议员。

en.s: The 1805 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1805, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Arthur Fenner won re-election against Federalist nominee Seth Wheaton. The exact number of votes cast in this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1805年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主共和党现任州长阿瑟·芬纳击败联邦党候选人塞思·惠顿，成功连任。具体票数已不可考。

en.s: The Great Sortie of Stralsund (Swedish: Stora utfallet från Stralsund) was fought in the Franco-Swedish War (part of the War of the Fourth Coalition) on 1–3 April 1807, in Swedish Pomerania (present-day Germany). A French army under Édouard Mortier invaded Swedish Pomerania in early 1807 and initiated a blockade of the Swedish town of Stralsund, to secure the French rear from enemy attacks.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 施特拉尔松德大突围（瑞典语：Stora utfallet från Stralsund）发生于1807年4月1日至3日，是法瑞战争（第四次反法同盟战争的一部分）期间的一场战斗，地点在当时的瑞属波美拉尼亚（今属德国）。爱德华·莫蒂埃率领的法军于1807年初入侵瑞属波美拉尼亚，并开始封锁瑞典城镇施特拉尔松德，以保护法军后方免受敌军袭击。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1809 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1809. Incumbent Democratic-Republican Governor Levi Lincoln Sr. had succeeded to the Governorship on the death of Governor James Sullivan on December 10, 1808. Lincoln was defeated for election to a term in his own right by Federalist nominee Christopher Gore.

zh.s: 1809年4月3日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。民主共和党人老利瓦伊·林肯在詹姆斯·沙利文州长于1808年12月10日去世后继任，此次寻求一个完整任期，但被联邦党候选人克里斯托弗·戈尔击败。

en.s: The 1811 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1811, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Federalist nominee William Jones defeated incumbent Democratic-Republican governor James Fenner.

zh.s: 1811年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人威廉·琼斯击败民主共和党现任州长詹姆斯·芬纳。

en.s: The Battle of Sabugal was a meeting engagement of the Peninsular War which took place on 3 April 1811 between Anglo-Portuguese forces under Arthur Wellesley (later the Duke of Wellington) and French troops under the command of Marshal André Masséna. It was the last of many skirmishes between Masséna's retreating French forces and those of the Anglo-Portuguese under Wellington, who were pursuing him after the failed 1810 French invasion of Portugal.

zh.s: 萨布加尔之战是半岛战争期间于1811年4月3日发生的一场遭遇战，交战双方是阿瑟·韦尔斯利（后来的威灵顿公爵）指挥的英葡联军和安德烈·马塞纳元帅指挥的法军。这是马塞纳撤退的法军与韦尔斯利率领的英葡联军之间最后一场小规模战斗；此前法军于1810年入侵葡萄牙未果，英葡联军一路追击。

en.s: The Battle of Rappahannock River was fought in 1813 during the War of 1812. A British Royal Navy force blockading the Rappahannock River in Virginia sent several hundred men in boats to attack four American privateers. Ultimately the British were victorious and the American ships were captured.

zh.s: 1813年，英美两国在1812年战争期间于弗吉尼亚州的拉帕汉诺克河交战。英国皇家海军封锁该河后，派出数百名士兵乘船袭击四艘美国私掠船，最终俘获这些船只并获胜。

en.s: The 1815 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1815, in order to elect the Governor of Massachusetts. Incumbent Federalist Governor Caleb Strong won re-election against Democratic-Republican candidate Samuel Dexter in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1815年4月3日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。联邦党现任州长凯莱布·斯特朗，再次对阵上届对手、民主共和党候选人塞缪尔·德克斯特，并成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of the Panaro (or Modena or Castelfranco) was a victory for King Joachim Murat's Neapolitan forces over a smaller Austrian force under Frederick Bianchi on 3 April 1815 early in the Neapolitan War. This defeat on the banks on the Panaro River, just south of Modena forced the Austrians to retreat behind the Po River.

zh.s: 帕纳罗河之战又称摩德纳之战或卡斯特尔弗兰科之战。1815年4月3日，那不勒斯国王约阿希姆·缪拉的军队在那不勒斯战争初期击败了弗雷德里克·比安基指挥的一支规模较小的奥地利军队。奥军在帕纳罗河岸边、摩德纳以南战败，被迫退至波河后方。

en.s: The 1820 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1820. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Brooks won re-election to a fifth term, defeating Democratic-Republican nominee William Eustis.

zh.s: 1820年4月3日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。联邦党现任州长约翰·布鲁克斯击败民主共和党候选人威廉·尤斯蒂斯，赢得第五个任期。

en.s: The 1820 Maine gubernatorial election took place on April 3, 1820. It was the first election for Governor of Maine, taking place after Maine separated from Massachusetts and was recognized as a state on March 15, 1820. Maine's separation from Massachusetts came as a result of The Missouri Compromise. The new Constitution of Maine kept some aspects of the Massachusetts form of government such as the Executive Council and the term of office only being one year.

zh.s: 1820年4月3日，缅因州举行首届州长选举。缅因此前脱离马萨诸塞州，于3月15日正式成为美国一州，这一分离是密苏里妥协案的一部分。缅因的新宪法保留了马萨诸塞政府体制的一些做法，例如行政委员会，以及州长一年一任的制度。

en.s: The 1826 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on April 3. Governor Levi Lincoln Jr., an Adams Republican, was re-elected to a second term over fractured opposition from the state's Federalists. This was the last election in which candidates stood as Federalists, as the party had been on the verge of collapse for years. The state soon coalesced into a dominant Adams Republican faction with a minority Jacksonian Republican group.

zh.s: 1826年4月3日，马萨诸塞州举行州长选举。亚当斯共和党籍州长利瓦伊·林肯二世击败分裂的反对派，连任第二个任期。这是候选人仍以联邦党人身份参选的最后一次选举，该党多年来一直濒临瓦解。此后，该州很快形成以亚当斯共和党派系为主、杰克逊共和党派系为少数的政治格局。

en.s: The 1833 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1833, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Democratic nominee and former member of the Rhode Island Senate John Brown Francis defeated incumbent National Republican governor Lemuel H. Arnold.

zh.s: 1833年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前州参议员约翰·布朗·弗朗西斯，击败国家共和党现任州长莱缪尔·H.阿诺德。

en.s: The battle of Matamoros was a naval engagement during the Texas Revolution on April 3, 1836, between the brig Montezuma of the Mexican Navy and the schooner Invincible of the Texas Navy. The Mexican ship was outmaneuvered and repeatedly hit before running aground and being abandoned.

zh.s: 1836年4月3日，得克萨斯革命期间，墨西哥海军双桅横帆船蒙特苏马号，与得克萨斯海军纵帆船无敌号交战，史称马塔莫罗斯海战。墨西哥舰只在机动中处于下风，多次中弹，最终搁浅并被弃船。

en.s: The 1837 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1837. Incumbent governor and Democratic nominee Henry W. Edwards was re-elected, defeating former congressman and Whig nominee William W. Ellsworth with 52.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1837年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长亨利·W.爱德华兹，以52.53%的得票率击败辉格党候选人、前国会议员威廉·W.埃尔斯沃思，成功连任。

en.s: The 1843 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1843. Incumbent governor and Democratic nominee Chauncey Fitch Cleveland was re-elected, defeating former state legislator, Amistad lawyer and Whig nominee Roger Sherman Baldwin with 50.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 1843年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长昌西·菲奇·克利夫兰，以50.13%的得票率击败辉格党候选人罗杰·谢尔曼·鲍德温，成功连任。鲍德温曾任州议员，也是阿米斯塔德案的律师。

en.s: The 1844 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1844. Incumbent Law and Order Governor James Fenner won re-election without opposition.

zh.s: 1844年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。法律与秩序党现任州长詹姆斯·芬纳，在没有竞争对手的情况下连任。

en.s: The Expedition to Canton was a British punitive expedition that captured the forts along the Pearl River, Guangdong province, China, on 2–3 April 1847. Beginning at the Humen Strait (Bogue), the British captured the forts leading up to the city of Canton (Guangzhou). The operation was in response to British subjects being attacked by the Chinese near Canton. Hong Kong Governor John Davis demanded redress from Chinese Commissioner Keying.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 广州远征是英国于1847年4月2日至3日发动的一次惩罚性远征，攻占了中国广东省珠江沿岸的多座炮台。英军从虎门开始，逐步攻占通往广州城的炮台。行动是为了回应英国人在广州附近遭中国人袭击一事。香港总督约翰·戴维斯要求中国钦差大臣耆英作出赔偿。

en.s: The 1848 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1848. Incumbent Governor and Whig nominee Clark Bissell was re-elected, defeating former congressman and Democratic nominee George S. Catlin with 50.38% of the vote. This was the last such election in which the Whig Party won a majority of the popular vote. Their vote share would steadily decline over each of the next eight elections, ending with their last appearance in the 1856 Connecticut gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1848年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。辉格党现任州长克拉克·比塞尔，以50.38%的得票率击败民主党候选人、前国会议员乔治·S.卡特林，成功连任。这是辉格党最后一次在该州州长选举中取得过半数普选票。随后八次选举，其得票率逐次下降，直到1856年最后一次参选。

en.s: The fourth siege of Szenttamás (now Srbobran, in the South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia) was a siege during the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848-1849, as a part of the Serb uprising of 1848–49, on 3 April 1849, carried out by the Hungarian Army under the command of General Mór Perczel against the Serbian fortified encampment in Szenttamás and Turia held by the Serb insurgents led by Captain Jovan Stefanović Vilovski.

zh.t: 第四次圣陶马什围城战
zh.s: 1849年4月3日，匈牙利独立战争期间，莫尔·佩尔采尔将军率匈牙利军进攻圣陶马什和图里亚的塞尔维亚设防营地。这是第四次圣陶马什围城战，也是1848—1849年塞族起义的一部分。防守者由约万·斯特凡诺维奇·维洛夫斯基上尉领导。圣陶马什即今塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那南巴奇卡区的斯尔博布兰。

en.s: The 1850 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1850, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Whig governor Henry B. Anthony won re-election against the Free Soil nominee Edward Harris in a rematch from the 1849 Rhode Island gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1850年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。辉格党现任州长亨利·B.安东尼，再次对阵1849年的对手、自由土地党候选人爱德华·哈里斯，并成功连任。

en.t: Rama IV is crowned King of Thailand after the death of his half-brother, Rama III
en.s: Mongkut (18 October 1804 – 1 October 1868), posthumously honoured as King Mongkut the Great was the king of Siam from the Chakri dynasty, titled Rama IV. He reigned from 1851 until his death in 1868. Although the term "Siam" had long been used by foreigners to refer to the kingdom, the title "King of Siam" came to be formally adopted during his reign, particularly in official and diplomatic contexts.

zh.t: 拉玛三世去世后，拉玛四世蒙固加冕为泰国国王
zh.s: 蒙固（1804年10月18日—1868年10月1日）逝世后获尊称为蒙固大帝，是却克里王朝的暹罗国王，称拉玛四世。他于1851年即位，在位至1868年去世。外国人长期以来用“暹罗”称呼该王国；“暹罗国王”这一称号则是在他统治期间，特别是在官方和外交场合，才正式采用。

en.s: The 1854 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1854. Former state legislator and Whig Party nominee Henry Dutton defeated former congressman and Democratic nominee Samuel Ingham and former congressman Charles Chapman with 31.89% of the vote. Although Ingham won a large plurality of the vote, he did not receive a majority. As a result, the Connecticut General Assembly elected the governor, per the state constitution.

zh.s: 1854年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。辉格党候选人、前州议员亨利·达顿获得31.89%的选票，最终击败民主党候选人、前国会议员塞缪尔·英厄姆，以及前国会议员查尔斯·查普曼。英厄姆虽以较大优势取得最多选票，却未超过半数。因此依照州宪法，由州议会决定州长人选，达顿当选。

en.s: The 1855 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on Tuesday, April 3, 1855, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a full term. Orsamus Cole unseated incumbent justice Samuel Crawford. Crawford likely lost due to his opinion in Booth v. Ableman (later appealed to the U.S. Supreme Court in Ableman v. Booth) that the Fugitive Slave Laws were unconstitutional.

zh.t: 1855年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1855年4月3日（星期二），威斯康星州举行最高法院选举，选出一名完整任期的大法官。奥萨穆斯·科尔击败现任大法官塞缪尔·克劳福德。克劳福德可能因其在Booth v. Ableman案中的意见而败选；该案后来上诉至美国最高法院，名为Ableman v. Booth。克劳福德认为《逃奴法》违宪。

en.s: A colonial election was held between 9 March and 3 April 1860 to elect members to the 2nd Parliament of South Australia. All 36 seats in the House of Assembly (the lower house), and two of the 18 seats in the Legislative Council (the upper house, which had two casual vacancies to be filled) were up for re-election.

zh.s: 1860年3月9日至4月3日，南澳大利亚殖民地举行选举，选出第二届议会成员。众议院（下院）36个席位全部改选；立法会（上院）18个席位中有两个因临时空缺而改选。

en.t: 1860 Wisconsin Supreme Court Chief Justice special election
en.s: The 1860 Wisconsin Supreme Court Chief Justice special election was a special election held on Tuesday, April 3, 1860, to elect the chief justice of the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Incumbent appointed chief justice Luther S. Dixon very narrowly won election to a partial term.

zh.t: 1860年威斯康星州最高法院首席大法官特别选举
zh.s: 1860年4月3日（星期二），威斯康星州举行最高法院首席大法官特别选举。由任命出任首席大法官的现任者卢瑟·S·迪克森以极小优势当选，获得部分任期。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Rhode Island on April 3, 1861. The incumbent Constitutional Union governor William Sprague IV defeated the Republican mayor of Providence James Y. Smith. Sprague won the 1860 election leading a coalition of Conservative Republicans, former Whigs, and Democrats that formed to oppose the Radical Republican gubernatorial candidate, Seth Padelford. Following the election, his supporters coalesced in the Constitutional Union Party.

zh.s: 1861年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。宪政联盟党现任州长威廉·斯普拉格四世，击败共和党的普罗维登斯市长詹姆斯·Y.史密斯。斯普拉格曾在1860年领导由保守派共和党人、前辉格党人和民主党人组成的联盟，反对激进共和党候选人塞思·帕德尔福德，并赢得选举。此后他的支持者合组宪政联盟党。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Rhode Island on April 3, 1864. The National Union incumbent governor James Y. Smith defeated the Democratic former U.S. representative from Rhode Island's 2nd congressional district George H. Browne and the Independent Union former mayor of Providence Amos C. Barstow.

zh.s: 1864年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。全国联盟党现任州长詹姆斯·Y.史密斯，击败民主党候选人、原罗得岛州第二选区联邦众议员乔治·H.布朗，以及独立联盟派候选人、前普罗维登斯市长阿莫斯·C.巴斯托。

en.s: The Battle of Namozine Church, Virginia was an engagement between Union Army and Confederate States Army forces that occurred on April 3, 1865 during the Appomattox Campaign of the American Civil War. The battle was the first engagement between units of General Robert E. Lee's Confederate Army of Northern Virginia after that army's evacuation of Petersburg and Richmond, Virginia on April 2, 1865 and units of the Union Army (Army of the Shenandoah, Army of the Potomac and Army of the James) under the immediate command of Maj. Gen.

zh.s: 1865年4月3日，美国南北战争的阿波马托克斯战役期间，联邦军与邦联军在弗吉尼亚州纳莫津教堂交战。罗伯特·E.李将军的北弗吉尼亚邦联军于4月2日撤离彼得斯堡和里士满，此役是撤离后首次与联邦军交锋。联邦军包括谢南多厄、波托马克和詹姆斯三个军团的部队。原文在介绍直接指挥这些部队的少将时中断。

en.s: The 1865 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1865, the last such election held during the American Civil War, and the last gubernatorial election in which the Republicans adopted the National Union Party name. It was a rematch of the 1864 Connecticut gubernatorial election. Incumbent governor and National Union nominee William Alfred Buckingham defeated Democratic nominee Origen S. Seymour with 57.48% of the vote.

zh.s: 1865年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。这是南北战争期间最后一次该州州长选举，也是共和党最后一次使用“全国联盟党”名称参加州长选举。全国联盟党现任州长威廉·阿尔弗雷德·白金汉，再次对阵1864年的民主党对手奥里根·S.西摩，以57.48%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1867 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1867, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Incumbent Republican governor Ambrose Burnside won re-election against Democratic nominee Lyman Pierce in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1867年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长安布罗斯·伯恩赛德，再次击败上届对手、民主党候选人莱曼·皮尔斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 1871 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1871. It was the fourth consecutive contest between the same two major party nominees. Former governor and Republican nominee Marshall Jewell defeated incumbent governor and Democratic nominee James E. English with 50.05% of the vote. The race was extremely close, with English finishing ahead in the initial count.

zh.s: 1871年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举，这是两大党同一对候选人连续第四次交锋。共和党候选人、前州长马歇尔·朱厄尔，以50.05%的得票率击败民主党现任州长詹姆斯·E.英格利希。竞争极其接近，最初计票时英格利希曾领先。

en.s: The Battle of Meudon took place on 3 April 1871 between the Paris Commune and Versaillais government forces near Meudon in the Île-de-France. The battle was part of the attempts by the Paris Commune to seize Versailles, the seat of Adolphe Thiers’ government, and it ended in a defeat for the Federates.

zh.s: 1871年4月3日，巴黎公社军队与凡尔赛政府军在法兰西岛大区默东附近交战。此战是巴黎公社试图夺取梯也尔政府所在地凡尔赛的一系列行动之一，最终公社联邦军战败。

en.s: The Battle of Rueil took place on 3 April 1871 between the Paris Commune and Versaillais government forces in the Île-de-France.

zh.s: 1871年4月3日，巴黎公社军队与凡尔赛政府军在法兰西岛大区的吕埃伊交战。

en.s: The 1872 Rhode Island gubernatorial election took place on April 3, 1872, in order to elect the governor of Rhode Island. Republican candidate and incumbent governor Seth Padelford won his fourth and final one-year term as governor against Democratic candidate Olney Arnold.

zh.s: 1872年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长塞思·帕德尔福德击败民主党候选人奥尔尼·阿诺德，赢得第四个、也是最后一个一年任期。

en.s: The April 1876 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1876. Incumbent governor and Democratic nominee Charles R. Ingersoll defeated Republican nominee H. Robinson with 51.85% of the vote. This was the last gubernatorial election held in April, and the only one to elect the governor of Connecticut to a term just short of eight months, from May 7, 1876, to January 3, 1877.

zh.s: 1876年4月3日，康涅狄格州举行州长选举。民主党现任州长查尔斯·R.英格索尔，以51.85%的得票率击败共和党候选人H.罗宾逊。这是该州最后一次在4月举行州长选举，也是唯一一次只选出不足八个月任期的州长，任期从1876年5月7日至1877年1月3日。

en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1877, Republican Monroe Heath was reelected, defeating Democrat Perry H. Smith by a more than twenty point margin. On April 23, 1875, Chicago had voted to operate under the Cities and Villages Act of 1872. This moved its mayoral elections from November to April.

zh.s: 1877年4月3日，美国芝加哥举行市长选举，共和党人门罗·希思击败民主党对手，成功连任。

en.s: The 1878 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1878. Incumbent Republican Charles C. Van Zandt defeated Democratic nominee Isaac Lawrence with 58.12% of the vote.

zh.s: 1878年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党现任州长查尔斯·C.范赞特，以58.12%的得票率击败民主党候选人艾萨克·劳伦斯。

en.s: The siege of Eshowe took place during the Anglo-Zulu War of 1879. The siege was part of a three-pronged attack on the Zulu Impis of king Cetshwayo at Ulundi. After an incursion as far as Eshowe (then also known as Fort Ekowe or kwaMondi) Colonel Charles Pearson was besieged there for two months by the Zulus.

zh.s: 埃绍韦围城战发生在1879年英祖战争期间，是对乌伦迪切什瓦约国王祖鲁军队的三路进攻之一。查尔斯·皮尔逊上校率军推进至埃绍韦（当时也称埃科韦堡或夸蒙迪）后，被祖鲁军围困两个月。

en.s: The Chicago mayoral election of 1883 was held on Tuesday April 3, saw incumbent Carter Harrison III defeat Republican Eugene Cary by a double-digit margin. By winning the 1883 election, Harrison became the second mayor in Chicago history to be elected to a third term (after only Francis Cornwall Sherman), and the first to be elected to a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 1883年4月3日（星期二），芝加哥举行市长选举。现任市长卡特·哈里森三世以两位数的得票优势击败共和党人尤金·凯里。赢得这次选举后，哈里森成为芝加哥历史上第二位连任第三个任期的市长（此前只有弗朗西斯·康沃尔·谢尔曼），也是首位连续当选三届的市长。

en.t: Gottlieb Daimler is granted a German patent for a light, high-speed, four-stroke engine, which he uses seven months later to create the world's first motorcycle, the Daimler Reitwagen
en.s: Gottlieb Wilhelm Daimler (German: [ˈɡɔtliːp ˈdaɪmlɐ]; 17 March 1834 – 6 March 1900) was a German engineer, industrial designer and industrialist. He was a pioneer of internal-combustion engines and automobile development. He invented the high-speed liquid petroleum-fueled engine. Daimler and his lifelong business partner Wilhelm Maybach were two inventors whose goal was to create small, high-speed engines to be mounted in any kind of locomotion device.

zh.t: 戈特利布·戴姆勒获颁德国专利，发明轻型高速四冲程发动机；七个月后，他用该发动机制造出世界首辆摩托车戴姆勒骑行车
zh.s: 戈特利布·威廉·戴姆勒（德语：[ˈɡɔtliːp ˈdaɪmlɐ]；1834年3月17日—1900年3月6日）是德国工程师、工业设计师和实业家。他是内燃机和汽车发展的先驱，发明了高速液态石油燃料发动机。戴姆勒与终身商业伙伴威廉·迈巴赫都是发明家，他们的目标是制造小型高速发动机，可安装在各种交通工具上。

en.s: The 1889 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1889. Democratic nominee John W. Davis received 49.38% of the vote and the Republican nominee Herbert W. Ladd 39.13%. With no candidate attaining a majority of the vote it was decided by the Rhode Island General Assembly. In the same election, the Republican Party had won a small majority in the legislature and selected Ladd as governor.

zh.s: 1889年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·W.戴维斯获得49.38%的选票，共和党候选人赫伯特·W.拉德获得39.13%。由于无人超过半数，选举交由州议会决定。共和党在同次选举中取得议会微弱多数，因此选出拉德担任州长。

en.s: The 1895 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on April 3, 1895. Republican nominee Charles W. Lippitt defeated Democratic nominee George L. Littlefield with 56.89% of the vote.

zh.s: 1895年4月3日，罗得岛州举行州长选举。共和党候选人查尔斯·W.利皮特以56.89%的得票率，击败民主党候选人乔治·L.利特尔菲尔德。

en.s: The Battle of Malakand Pass pass took place in the Malakand Pass between a British expeditionary force commanded by Robert Low, a General of the British Indian Army against tribal Chitralis during the Chitral Expedition.

zh.s: 1895年4月3日，英军与当地武装在今天巴基斯坦的马拉坎德山口交战，英军获胜。

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1899 was the 52nd mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Monday, April 3, 1899. Democratic party incumbent mayor Samuel L. Black was defeated by Republican party nominee Samuel J. Swartz.

zh.t: 1899年俄亥俄州哥伦布市长选举
zh.s: 1899年4月3日星期一，美国俄亥俄州哥伦布举行第52次市长选举。民主党现任市长塞缪尔·L.布莱克，被共和党候选人塞缪尔·J.斯沃茨击败。

en.s: An election for Mayor of Milwaukee was held on April 3, 1900. Incumbent mayor David S. Rose was re-elected with 50% of the vote. Candidates included incumbent mayor David S. Rose, Republican Henry J. Baumgaertner, and a Social Democrat.

zh.s: 1900年4月3日，密尔沃基举行市长选举。现任市长戴维·S·罗斯以50%的得票率连任。候选人还包括共和党人亨利·J·鲍姆加特纳和一名社会民主党人。

en.t: Association football club Boca Juniors is founded in Buenos Aires, Argentina
en.s: Club Atlético Boca Juniors (CABJ) (Spanish pronunciation: [kluβ aˈtletiko ˈβoka ˈʝunjoɾs]) is an Argentine professional sports club based in La Boca, a neighbourhood of Buenos Aires. The club is best known for its men's professional football team which, since its debut in Primera División in 1913, has always played in the top division. The team has won 74 official titles, the most by any Argentine club.

zh.t: 博卡青年足球俱乐部成立
zh.s: 1905年4月3日，几名意大利移民后代在阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯创立博卡青年足球俱乐部。

en.s: The 1906 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on Tuesday, April 3, 1906, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. The election was the first election to fill the newly created seventh seat on the court. Attorney William H. Timlin prevailed in a four-candidate race, winning a plurality of the vote.

en.s: An election for Mayor of Milwaukee was held on April 3, 1906. Sherburn M. Becker was elected with 37% of the vote. Candidates included Milwaukee alderman Sherburn M. Becker, incumbent mayor David S. Rose, and Social Democrat William A. Arnold. As of 2025, this is the last time a Republican was elected Mayor of Milwaukee.

en.s: Baron Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim (Finland Swedish: [kɑːrl ˈɡʉstɑv ˈeːmil ˈmɑnːærhejm] , 4 June 1867 – 27 January 1951) was a Finnish military commander and statesman. en.s: In the Chicago mayoral election of 1923, Democrat William E. Dever defeated Republican Arthur C. Lueder and Socialist William A. Cunnea. en.s: The Northern Ireland general election, 1925 was held on 3 April 1925. It was the second election to the Parliament of Northern Ireland. It saw significant losses for the Ulster Unionist Party, although they maintained their large majority. This was the last election for the Stormont parliament conducted using the Proportional Representation system. It was abolished by the Ulster Unionist government during this parliament and replaced with the first-past-the-post system used in Great Britain.

zh.s: 1925年4月3日，北爱尔兰举行第二次议会选举。阿尔斯特统一党席位大减，但仍保持较大多数。这是北爱尔兰议会最后一次采用比例代表制选举。该届议会任期内，统一党政府将其废除，改为英国本土使用的得票领先者当选制。

en.t: Bruno Richard Hauptmann is executed for the kidnapping and death of Charles Augustus Lindbergh Jr., the infant son of pilot Charles Lindbergh
en.s: Bruno Richard Hauptmann (November 26, 1899 – April 3, 1936) was a German-American carpenter and criminal who was convicted of the abduction and murder of Charles Augustus Lindbergh Jr., the 20-month-old son of aviator Charles Lindbergh and his wife Anne Morrow Lindbergh. The Lindbergh kidnapping became known as the "crime of the century". He was executed in 1936 by electric chair at the Trenton State Prison.

en.s: The Bataan Death March was the forcible transfer by the Imperial Japanese Army of around 72,000 to 78,000 Filipino (about 66,000) and American (about 12,000) prisoners of war (POWs) from the municipalities of Bagac and Mariveles on the Bataan Peninsula to Camp O'Donnell via San Fernando. en.s: The Jeju uprising was an attempted insurgency on the Korean province of Jeju Island which was followed by a brutal anticommunist suppression campaign that lasted from April 3 1948 until May 1949. The main cause for the rebellion was elections scheduled for May 10, 1948, designed by the United Nations Temporary Commission on Korea (UNTCOK) to create a new government for all of Korea. The elections, however, were only planned for the south of the country, the half of the peninsula under UNTCOK control. Fearing the elections would further reinforce division, guerrilla fighters for the South Korean Labor party (SKLP) reacted violently, attacking local police and rightist youth groups stationed on Jeju Island.

zh.s: 济州岛四三事件始于一次起义尝试，随后遭到残酷的反共镇压，时间从1948年4月3日持续至1949年5月。起义的主要诱因，是定于1948年5月10日举行的选举。联合国朝鲜临时委员会原计划通过选举建立覆盖整个朝鲜半岛的新政府，但实际只在其控制的半岛南部举行。担心选举将进一步加深分裂的南朝鲜劳动党游击队采取暴力行动，袭击济州岛当地警察和驻岛右翼青年团体。

en.s: (Main article: Ho Chi Minh Trail) Operation Steel Tiger was a covert U.S. 2nd Air Division, later Seventh Air Force and U.S. Navy Task Force 77 aerial interdiction effort targeted against the infiltration of People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) men and material moving south from the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (DRV or North Vietnam) through southeastern Laos to support their military effort in the Republic of Vietnam (RVN or South Vietnam) during the Vietnam War. The operation was initiated by the 2nd Air Division on 3 April 1965, continued under the direction of the Seventh Air Force when that headquarters was created on 1 April 1966, and was concluded on 11 November 1968 with the initiation of Operation Commando Hunt.

zh.s: “钢虎”是越南战争期间美军实施的秘密空中拦截行动，目标是阻止越南人民军人员和物资从越南民主共和国（北越），经老挝东南部南下，支援其在越南共和国（南越）的军事行动。这条运输路线与胡志明小道有关。行动由美国第二航空师于1965年4月3日发起，美国海军第77特遣舰队也参与其中。第七航空队于1966年4月1日成立后接管指挥。行动于1968年11月11日结束，由“突击队猎杀”行动接替。

en.s: The Aniversario de Arena México (Spanish for "Arena México Anniversary") show is an annual major professional wrestling show produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) to commemorate the opening of Arena México, the promotion's main venue, in 1956. The event usually takes place in April with very few exceptions in place of the promotion's regular Friday Night Super Viernes series of shows.

zh.t: 墨西哥竞技场周年纪念赛
zh.s: 墨西哥竞技场周年纪念赛（西班牙语：Aniversario de Arena México）是世界摔角理事会（CMLL）每年举办的大型职业摔角赛事，纪念该组织主场墨西哥竞技场于1956年开幕。赛事通常在4月举行，少数年份例外，并取代该组织常规的周五晚间Super Viernes系列节目。

en.s: Operation Desert Rat (16 February – 3 April 1971) was a diversionary attack by a Laotian irregular regiment upon the crucial communist supply line, the Ho Chi Minh trail. Carried out by the Central Intelligence Agency sponsored Groupement Mobile 33, the Desert Rat offensive struck the rear of the 50,000 North Vietnamese troops combating Operation Lam Son 719 beginning on 16 February 1971.

en.t: Release of Kamen Rider (1971 TV series)
en.s: Kamen Rider (仮面ライダー, Kamen Raidā) is a Japanese tokusatsu superhero television series and weekly science fiction manga created by manga artist Shotaro Ishinomori. The original airing consisted of a total of 98 episodes and were broadcast from April 3, 1971, to February 10, 1973, on Mainichi Broadcasting System and NET (now TV Asahi). The manga adaptation was also featured in Shōnen Magazine around the same period.

zh.s: 《假面骑士》（仮面ライダー，Kamen Raidā）是日本特摄超级英雄电视剧和每周连载的科幻漫画，由漫画家石森章太郎创作。电视剧共播出98集，1971年4月3日至1973年2月10日在每日放送和NET（今朝日电视台）播出。漫画改编版也在同一时期刊载于《少年Magazine》。

en.s: The 1973 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 3, 1973 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the election of John Poelker and the defeat of incumbent mayor Alfonso Cervantes in the Democratic primary. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 6.

zh.s: 1973年4月3日，密苏里州圣路易斯举行市长选举。约翰·波尔克当选，民主党初选中现任市长阿方索·塞万提斯落败。选举前，政党初选已于3月6日举行。

en.s: The 1973 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on April 3, 1973, with a run-off election on May 29, 1973. Incumbent Sam Yorty was defeated by councilman Tom Bradley in a rematch of the 1969 mayoral election. Yorty's growing apathy towards the office of Mayor and his previous tactics against Bradley would be the main points of criticisms towards him, and coupled with Bradley's popularity would lead to his defeat.

zh.s: 1973年4月3日，洛杉矶举行市长选举，并于5月29日举行第二轮投票。现任市长萨姆·约蒂在与1969年相同的对决中败给市议员汤姆·布拉德利。约蒂对市长职务日渐缺乏热情，以及他此前攻击布拉德利的手法，成为外界批评的重点；再加上布拉德利颇受欢迎，最终导致约蒂落败。

en.s: Operation Babylift was a mass evacuation of children from South Vietnam to the United States and other Western countries at end of the Vietnam War, in April 1975. Over 3,300 infants and children were airlifted, although the actual number has been variously reported.
en.n: Vietnam War: Operation Babylift, a mass evacuation of children in the closing stages of the war begins.

zh.s: 婴儿空运行动是越南战争末期、1975年4月开展的一次大规模儿童撤离行动，将儿童从南越转移至美国和其他西方国家。共有3,300多名婴幼儿和儿童乘飞机撤离，但实际人数的说法不一。
zh.n: 越南战争：婴儿空运行动开始，这是战争末期大规模撤离儿童的行动。

en.s: The 1979 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 3, 1979, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Shirley Abrahamson (who had been appointed to fill a vacancy) won the election, defeating Howard H. Boyle Jr.

zh.t: 1979年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1979年4月3日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。此前获任命填补空缺的现任法官雪莉·亚伯拉罕森，击败小霍华德·H.博伊尔，赢得选举。

en.s: The 1979 Navarrese foral election was held on 3 April 1979 to elect the Foral Parliament of Navarre. All 70 seats in the Parliament were up for election. It was held concurrently with local elections all throughout Spain.

zh.s: 1979年4月3日，西班牙纳瓦拉举行自治特权议会选举，改选全部70席。这次选举与西班牙全国地方选举同期进行。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Madrid on 3 April 1979 to elect the 1st City Council of the municipality. All 59 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with local elections all across Spain. The Union of the Democratic Centre (UCD) emerged as the most voted party, but in a seat tie with the second force, the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE), at 25 seats.

zh.s: 1979年4月3日，马德里举行首届市议会选举，改选全部59席，与西班牙全国地方选举同期进行。民主中间派联盟得票最多，但与第二大力量西班牙工人社会党各得25席，在席位数上打平。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Valencia on 3 April 1979 to elect the 1st City Council of the municipality. All 33 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 1979年4月3日，瓦伦西亚举行首届市议会选举，改选全部33席，与西班牙全国地方选举同期进行。

en.s: A municipal election was held in Seville on 3 April 1979 to elect the 1st City Council of the municipality. All 31 seats in the City Council were up for election. It was held concurrently with local elections all across Spain.

zh.s: 1979年4月3日，塞维利亚举行市政选举，选出该市首届市议会的31名成员。选举与西班牙各地的地方选举同期举行。

en.t: The Osborne 1, the first successful portable computer, is unveiled at the West Coast Computer Faire in San Francisco
en.s: The Osborne 1 is the first commercially successful portable computer, released on April 3, 1981, by Osborne Computer Corporation. It weighs 24.5 lb (11.1 kg), cost US$1,795, and runs the CP/M 2.2 operating system. It is powered from a wall socket, as it has no on-board battery, but it is still classed as a portable device since it can be hand-carried when the keyboard is closed.

zh.t: 奥斯本1号电脑在旧金山西海岸电脑博览会上发布
zh.s: 奥斯本1号是首款取得商业成功的便携式电脑，由奥斯本电脑公司于1981年4月3日发布。它重24.5磅（11.1公斤），售价1,795美元，运行CP/M 2.2操作系统。它只能连接墙上电源，没有内置电池；但合上键盘后可以手提携带，因此仍被归为便携设备。

en.s: The invasion of South Georgia (Spanish: Operación Georgias), also known as the Battle of Grytviken, took place on 3 April 1982, when Argentine naval forces seized control of the east coast of South Georgia after overpowering a small group of Royal Marines at Grytviken. The Argentine intervention had begun on 19 March, when a group of civilian scrap metal workers illegally arrived at Leith Harbour on board the transport ship ARA Bahía Buen Suceso and raised the Argentine flag. The scrap workers had been infiltrated by Argentine marines posing as civilian scientists.

zh.t: 阿根廷入侵南乔治亚岛
zh.s: 1982年4月3日，阿根廷海军在古利特维肯击败一小队英国皇家海军陆战队，控制南乔治亚岛东海岸。这次行动也称古利特维肯战役。阿根廷的介入始于3月19日，一群废金属回收工人乘阿根廷运输舰布恩苏塞索湾号，未经许可抵达利斯港，升起阿根廷国旗。其中混入了伪装成平民科学家的阿根廷海军陆战队员。

en.s: The 1982 Victoria state election was held on Saturday, 3 April 1982, for the 49th Parliament of Victoria to elect 81 members of the state's Legislative Assembly and 22 members of the 44-member Legislative Council. Lindsay Thompson succeeded Rupert Hamer as Liberal Party leader and Premier on 5 June 1981, and John Cain Jr. replaced Frank Wilkes as Labor Party leader in September 1981.

zh.s: 1982年4月3日（星期六），澳大利亚维多利亚州举行选举，选出第49届议会的81名下议院议员和立法会44席中的22名议员。林赛·汤普森于1981年6月5日接替鲁珀特·哈默，出任自由党领袖和州长；约翰·凯恩二世于1981年9月接替弗兰克·威尔克斯，出任工党领袖。

en.s: The 1983 Bulgarian Cup final was the 43rd final of the Bulgarian Cup, and was contested between CSKA Sofia and Spartak Varna on 3 April 1983 at Plovdiv Stadium in Plovdiv. CSKA won the final 4–0.

zh.s: 1983年保加利亚杯决赛是第43届保加利亚杯决赛，于1983年4月3日在普罗夫迪夫体育场举行，由索菲亚中央陆军对阵瓦尔纳斯巴达克。索菲亚中央陆军以4比0获胜。

en.s: The 1984 Guinean coup d'état was the bloodless military coup that took place in Guinea on 3 April 1984, led by Colonel Lansana Conté. It led to the deposition of Prime Minister Louis Lansana Beavogui, who had held the office since 1972, and had been serving as interim president since 26 March, when longtime President Ahmed Sékou Touré died during an emergency heart operation at the Cleveland Clinic in the United States.

zh.s: 1984年4月3日，兰萨纳·孔戴上校在几内亚发动不流血军事政变，推翻路易·兰萨纳·贝阿沃吉。贝阿沃吉自1972年起担任总理，并在长期总统艾哈迈德·塞古·杜尔于3月26日在美国克利夫兰诊所接受紧急心脏手术时去世后，兼任临时总统。

en.t: Mississippi Band of Choctaw Indians v. Holyfield
en.s: Mississippi Band of Choctaw Indians v. Holyfield, 490 U.S. 30 (1989), was a case in which the Supreme Court of the United States held that the Indian Child Welfare Act governed adoptions of Indian children. It ruled that a tribal court had jurisdiction over a state court, regardless of the location of birth of the child, if the child or the natural parents resided on the reservation.
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 密西西比州乔克托印第安人部落诉霍利菲尔德案
zh.s: 在密西西比州乔克托印第安人部落诉霍利菲尔德案（490 U.S. 30，1989年）中，美国最高法院裁定，《印第安儿童福利法》适用于印第安儿童的收养。法院裁定，如果儿童或其亲生父母居住在保留地内，部落法院对案件有管辖权，即使儿童出生地点不在保留地也一样。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是源信息框所列裁决日期。

en.t: 1990 Liberal Party of Australia leadership election
en.s: A spill of the leadership of the Liberal Party of Australia took place on 3 April 1990, following the defeat of the Liberal Party at the federal election five days earlier. The spill was won by John Hewson over Peter Reith by 62 votes to 13. Reith was then elected deputy leader of the Party.

zh.t: 1990年澳大利亚自由党领导人选举
zh.s: 自由党在联邦大选败选五天后，于1990年4月3日举行领导层改选。约翰·休森以62票对13票击败彼得·里思，成为党领袖。里思随后当选副领袖。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 3 April 1990 following the abolition of the State Council, the collective presidency of the Communist era. Members of the National Assembly elected a new president, with Petar Mladenov, former chair of the State Council, being elected unanimously.

zh.s: 保加利亚废除共产党时期集体行使国家元首职权的国务委员会后，于1990年4月3日举行间接总统选举。国民议会议员一致选出原国务委员会主席彼得·姆拉德诺夫为新总统。

en.s: The 1990 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 3, 1990, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice Donald W. Steinmetz was re-elected over Richard S. Brown (a judge on the state Appeals Court).

zh.t: 1990年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 1990年4月3日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官唐纳德·W.斯坦梅茨击败州上诉法院法官理查德·S.布朗，成功连任。

en.t: 1991 Turks and Caicos Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the Turks and Caicos Islands on 3 April 1991. The result was a victory for the opposition Progressive National Party (PNP), which won eight of the thirteen seats in the Legislative Council. Following the elections, PNP leader Washington Misick became Chief Minister.

zh.t: 1991年特克斯和凯科斯群岛大选
zh.s: 特克斯和凯科斯群岛于1991年4月3日举行大选。反对党进步民族党赢得立法会13席中的八席，取得胜利。选后，该党领袖华盛顿·米西克成为首席部长。

en.s: The Battle of Sulaymaniyah was one of the battles fought during the 1991 uprisings in Iraq. Sulaymaniyah, a mostly Kurdish city with a population of over 100,000, was the first to be liberated by the rebels and the last to fall back to the Iraqi army. After three months the city was captured by Kurdish forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 苏莱曼尼亚之战是1991年伊拉克起义期间发生的一场战斗。苏莱曼尼亚是一座以库尔德人为主、人口超过10万的城市，是叛军解放的第一座城市，也是最后一座重新落入伊拉克军队之手的城市。三个月后，库尔德部队攻占该城。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Operation Baranja (Croatian: Operacija Baranja) was an aborted offensive of the Croatian Army (Hrvatska vojska – HV) north of the towns of Belišće and Valpovo, Croatia on 3 April 1992 during the Croatian War of Independence. The offensive quickly gained ground after the HV advanced north of the Drava River into Baranja. The defending force of the Croatian Serb Territorial Defence Force supported by the Yugoslav People's Army (Jugoslovenska Narodna Armija – JNA) artillery were caught unprepared and offered light resistance. However, the offensive was not authorised and it was cancelled six hours after it had been launched.

zh.s: 1992年4月3日，克罗地亚独立战争期间，克罗地亚军在贝利什切与瓦尔波沃以北发动“巴拉尼亚行动”，但进攻很快被叫停。部队越过德拉瓦河向北进入巴拉尼亚后迅速推进。防守的克罗地亚塞族领土防卫军虽获南斯拉夫人民军炮兵支援，却措手不及，抵抗较弱。然而这场攻势并未获授权，开始六小时后便被取消。

en.s: The Battle of Kalbajar took place in March and April 1993, during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. It resulted in the capture of the Kalbajar District of Azerbaijan by Armenian military forces. Kalbajar lies outside the contested enclave of the former Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast (NKAO). The offensive was the first time Armenian forces from Nagorno-Karabakh had advanced beyond the boundaries of the enclave (besides the capture of Lachin in 1992). Kalbajar District, located between Armenia and the western border of the former NKAO, was composed of several dozen villages and its provincial capital, also named Kalbajar. The Armenian side launched an attack from four directions, including Armenia proper. After initial heavy resistance, the Azerbaijani defence quickly collapsed and the provincial capital fell on April 3, 1993.

zh.s: 卡尔巴贾尔之战发生于1993年3月至4月，是第一次纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争的一部分。亚美尼亚军队攻占了阿塞拜疆的卡尔巴贾尔区。该区位于前纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫自治州争议飞地之外，处于亚美尼亚与该飞地西部边界之间，由数十个村庄和同名区首府组成。此次攻势是纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫的亚美尼亚部队首次推进到飞地边界以外（1992年攻占拉钦除外）。亚美尼亚方面从四个方向发动进攻，其中包括从亚美尼亚本土发起的一路。最初遭到激烈抵抗后，阿塞拜疆防线迅速瓦解，区首府于1993年4月3日失守。

en.t: The outcome of the Grand National horse race is declared void for the first (and only) time
en.s: The Grand National is a National Hunt horse race held annually at Aintree Racecourse in Aintree, Merseyside, England, near Liverpool. First run in 1839 as the Grand Liverpool Steeplechase, it is a handicap steeplechase over 4 miles 2+1⁄2 furlongs (4 miles 550 yards; 7 kilometres), with horses jumping 30 fences over two laps. It is the most valuable jump race in Europe, with a prize fund of £1 million in 2017.

zh.t: 1993年英国国家障碍赛结果作废
zh.s: 1993年4月3日，英国国家障碍赛因起跑混乱被判结果无效，是这项赛事首次出现这样的情况。

en.s: The 1994 Recopa Sudamericana was the sixth Recopa Sudamericana, an annual football match between the winners of the previous season's Copa Libertadores and Supercopa Sudamericana competitions. This year's edition pitted the defending champions São Paulo against compatriots Botafogo in a second, consecutive all-Brazilian final. Since São Paulo won both the 1993 Copa Libertadores and 1993 Supercopa Sudamericana, CONMEBOL invited Botafogo, winners of the 1993 Copa CONMEBOL, to participate in order to make this year's Recopa doable.

zh.s: 1994年南美优胜者杯是第六届赛事，按惯例由上一赛季南美解放者杯冠军对阵南美超级杯冠军。该届决赛由卫冕冠军圣保罗对阵同为巴西球队的博塔弗戈，连续第二届出现全巴西球队对决。由于圣保罗同时赢得1993年南美解放者杯和南美超级杯，南美足联邀请了1993年南美俱乐部杯冠军博塔弗戈参赛。

en.s: On April 3, 1996, a United States Air Force Boeing CT-43A (Flight IFO-21) crashed on approach to Dubrovnik, Croatia, while on an official trade mission. The aircraft, a Boeing 737-200 originally built as T-43A navigational trainer and later converted into a CT-43A executive transport aircraft, was carrying United States Secretary of Commerce Ron Brown and 34 other people, including The New York Times Frankfurt bureau chief Nathaniel C. Nash. While attempting an instrument approach to Dubrovnik Airport, the airplane crashed into a mountainside. Air Force Technical Sergeant Shelly Kelly survived the initial impact, but died en route to hospital.

zh.s: 1996年4月3日，美国空军一架波音CT-43A飞机，航班号IFO-21，在执行官方贸易访问任务、进近克罗地亚杜布罗夫尼克时坠毁。飞机原为波音737-200改成的T-43A导航教练机，后来再改为CT-43A行政运输机。机上载有美国商务部长罗恩·布朗及另外34人，包括《纽约时报》法兰克福分社社长纳撒尼尔·C.纳什。飞机进行仪表进近时撞上山坡。空军技术军士谢莉·凯利在最初撞击后仍然生还，但在送医途中去世。

en.s: On 3 April 1996, Liverpool faced Newcastle United in a Premier League fixture at Anfield, during the 1995–96 season. Liverpool won the match, scoring four goals to Newcastle's three. The winning goal was scored by striker Stan Collymore in the second minute of stoppage time. Before the match, both clubs had lost their previous fixtures but still had a chance of winning the league and wanted to close the gap between themselves and leaders Manchester United.

zh.t: 利物浦4比3纽卡斯尔联（1996年）
zh.s: 1996年4月3日，利物浦在1995—96赛季英超联赛中于安菲尔德迎战纽卡斯尔联。利物浦以4比3获胜，前锋斯坦·科利莫尔在伤停补时第二分钟打入制胜球。赛前，两队都刚输掉上一场比赛，但仍有机会争夺联赛冠军，希望缩小与领头羊曼彻斯特联的积分差距。

en.s: The Thalit massacre took place in Thalit village (Médéa, near Ksar el Boukhari), some 70 km from Algiers, on April 3–4, 1997. 52 out of the 53 inhabitants were killed by slitting their throats. The homes of the villagers were burned down after. The attack was attributed to Islamist guerrillas.

zh.s: 1997年4月3日至4日，阿尔及利亚塔利特村发生屠杀。该村位于麦迪亚地区、布哈里堡附近，距阿尔及尔约70公里。53名居民中有52人被割喉杀害，村民房屋随后被焚毁。袭击被归咎于伊斯兰主义游击队。

en.s: The 1995 Copa Interamericana was the 17th. edition of the Copa Interamericana. The final took place between Costa Rican club Deportivo Saprissa (winner of 1995 CONCACAF Champions' Cup) and Colombian side Atlético Nacional (1995 Copa Libertadores runner-up so current champion Grêmio declined to participate. Unlike previous editions, the final was staged over just one match, being held on April 3, 1997, in San José, Costa Rica.

zh.s: 1995年洲际杯是第17届赛事。决赛由哥斯达黎加的萨普里萨队（1995年中北美冠军杯冠军）对阵哥伦比亚的国民竞技队（1995年南美解放者杯亚军）。由于卫冕冠军格雷米奥拒绝参赛，比赛只进行一场，于1997年4月3日在哥斯达黎加圣何塞举行。
zh.n: 这届赛事以1995年命名，决赛实际在1997年4月举行。

en.s: CyberSlam (1999) was the fourth CyberSlam professional wrestling event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). The event took place on April 3, 1999 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Eight professional wrestling matches took place at the event. The main event was an Ultimate Jeopardy match, in which former tag team partners from The Gangstas, New Jack and Mr. Mustafa competed in opposing teams.

zh.s: 1999年“网络大满贯”是极限冠军摔角联盟（ECW）制作的第四届同名职业摔角赛事，于4月3日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城ECW竞技场举行，共八场比赛。压轴赛采用“终极危机”规则，原“匪帮”双打搭档新杰克和穆斯塔法先生，各自在不同队伍中交锋。

en.s: The 2001 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 3, 2001, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Incumbent justice David Prosser Jr. was re-elected unopposed.

zh.t: 2001年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2001年4月3日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官小戴维·普罗瑟因无竞争对手而连任。

en.s: The 2001 St. Louis mayoral election was held on April 3, 2001 to elect the mayor of St. Louis, Missouri. It saw the election of Francis Slay and the defeat of incumbent mayor Clarence Harmon in the Democratic primary. The election was preceded by party primaries on March 6.

zh.s: 2001年4月3日，密苏里州圣路易斯举行市长选举。弗朗西斯·斯雷当选，民主党初选中现任市长克拉伦斯·哈蒙落败。选举前，政党初选已于3月6日举行。

en.s: The 2002 Turkish Cup final was a football match played on 3 April 2002 at the Bursa Atatürk Stadium in Bursa. It was the final and deciding match of the 2001–02 Turkish Cup.

zh.s: 2002年土耳其杯决赛于2002年4月3日在布尔萨的布尔萨阿塔图尔克体育场举行，是2001—02赛季土耳其杯的决赛暨冠军决胜战。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Slovakia on 3 April 2004, with a second round on 17 April. Although former Prime Minister Vladimír Mečiar received the most votes in the first round, he was defeated by Ivan Gašparovič in the run-off. The result was surprising because nobody expected Eduard Kukan to be eliminated in the first round. He polled 1st prior the first round with over 30% support. Ivan Gašparovič himself didn't expect to qualify for the second round as he went home to sleep and found out about his success only when he was waken up by phone calls of his friends.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克于2004年4月3日举行总统选举，第二轮于4月17日进行。前总理弗拉迪米尔·梅恰尔在首轮得票最多，却在决选中败给伊万·加什帕罗维奇。结果出乎意料，因为选前民调以超过30%支持率领先的爱德华·库坎，竟在首轮出局。加什帕罗维奇自己也未料到能晋级，已回家睡觉，直到朋友打电话叫醒他，才知道进入第二轮。

en.s: WrestleMania 21, also promoted as WrestleMania Goes Hollywood, was a 2005 professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It was the 21st annual WrestleMania and took place on April 3, 2005, at the Staples Center in Los Angeles, California, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw and SmackDown! brand divisions.

zh.s: 第二十一届摔角狂热又以“摔角狂热进军好莱坞”为宣传主题，是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2005年4月3日在美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶斯台普斯中心举行，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown两个品牌。

en.s: April 2006 Iran–Iraq cross-border raids were three military cross-border attacks on Iran-Iraqi Kurdistan border, in which PJAK claimed to have killed 24 members of Iranian security forces in early April, 2006. The raids were motivated as retaliation for the killing of 10 Kurds demonstrating in Maku by Iranian security forces. On April 10, 2006, seven PJAK members were arrested in Iran, on a suspicion that they had killed three Iranian security force personnel.

zh.s: 2006年4月3日，伊朗与伊拉克边境发生跨境袭击，库尔德武装PJAK宣称袭击造成伊朗安全部队伤亡。

en.s: The 2007 Brown County, Wisconsin Executive election took place on April 3, 2007, following a primary election on February 20, 2007. Incumbent County Executive Carol Kelso did not run for a second term. Three candidates ran to succeed her: former Sheriff Tom Hinz, State Senator Alan Lasee, and County Supervisor Patrick Evans.

zh.t: 2007年威斯康星州布朗县县长选举
zh.s: 2007年4月3日，美国威斯康星州布朗县举行县长选举，此前已于2月20日举行初选。现任县长卡萝尔·凯尔索不再寻求第二个任期。三人竞逐继任者职位：前治安官汤姆·欣茨、州参议员艾伦·拉西，以及县议员帕特里克·埃文斯。

en.s: The 2007 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on April 3, 2007, to elect the mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Mayor Oscar Goodman, a Democrat in office since 1999, received a majority of votes in the first round of the election, and was reelected to a third term in office with no need for a runoff.

zh.s: 2007年4月3日，美国内华达州拉斯维加斯举行市长选举，与其他多项地方选举同期进行。选举正式采用无党派形式。自1999年起任职的民主党现任市长奥斯卡·古德曼，在首轮取得过半数选票，无须决选便赢得第三个任期。

en.s: The 2007 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 3, 2007, to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. Washington County circuit court judge Annette Ziegler defeated Madison attorney Linda M. Clifford. As more than two candidates filed to run, a nonpartisan election was held on February 20, 2007 in which attorney Joseph Sommers was eliminated. Incumbent justice Jon P.

zh.t: 2007年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2007年4月3日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。华盛顿县巡回法院法官安妮特·齐格勒，击败麦迪逊律师琳达·M.克利福德。由于报名者超过两人，2月20日曾举行无党派初选，律师约瑟夫·萨默斯在其中被淘汰。原文在介绍现任法官的姓名“Jon P.”时中断。

en.s: The 2007 Outagamie County Executive election took place on April 3, 2007, to select the County Executive of Outagamie County, Wisconsin. Incumbent County Executive Toby Paltzer ran for re-election to a third term, despite a pledge after his 2003 re-election to not seek another term. He was challenged by County Board Supervisor Chuck Schmidt, who campaigned on a need to cut spending.

zh.s: 2007年4月3日，美国威斯康星州奥塔加米县举行县长选举。现任县长托比·帕尔策曾在2003年连任后承诺不再参选，但这次仍寻求第三个任期。县议员查克·施密特向他挑战，主张削减开支。

en.s: The 2007 Wichita mayoral election took place on April 3, 2007, to elect the Mayor of Wichita, Kansas. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. It saw the election of Carl Brewer, who unseated incumbent mayor Carlos Mayans. Brewer was the first African American to be elected mayor of Wichita.

zh.s: 2007年4月3日，美国堪萨斯州威奇托举行市长选举，与其他多项地方选举同期进行。选举正式采取无党派形式。卡尔·布鲁尔击败现任市长卡洛斯·马扬斯，成为首位经选举出任威奇托市长的非洲裔美国人。

en.s: The 2007 Colorado Springs mayoral election took place on April 3, 2007, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.t: 2007年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举
zh.s: 2007年4月3日，科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯举行市长选举，并与其他多项地方选举同期进行。选举正式不设党派标签。

en.s: Supercard of Honor IV was a professional wrestling event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH). It was the fourth Supercard of Honor and took place on April 3, 2009 at George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston, Texas. As with other Supercard of Honor events, it took place in the same weekend and same metropolitan area as WrestleMania 25.

zh.s: 第四届荣耀超级大赛是荣耀擂台（ROH）制作的职业摔角赛事，于2009年4月3日在美国得克萨斯州休斯敦乔治·R.布朗会议中心举行。与该系列其他赛事一样，它和第二十五届摔角狂热安排在同一个周末、同一个都会区举行。

en.s: On April 3, 2009, a mass shooting occurred at the American Civic Association immigration center in Binghamton, New York. At approximately 10:30 a.m. EDT, Jiverly Wong (also known as Jiverly Voong) entered the facility and killed thirteen people and wounded four others before committing suicide. It is the deadliest mass shooting in the state of New York.

zh.s: 2009年4月3日，美国纽约州宾厄姆顿的美国公民协会移民中心发生大规模枪击案。上午约10时30分，杰弗里·黄（又名Jiverly Voong）进入该设施，杀死13人、打伤4人，随后自杀。这是纽约州伤亡最严重的大规模枪击案。

en.s: The Big Bang! was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Ring of Honor (ROH), which was only available online. It took place on April 3, 2010 from the Grady Cole Center in Charlotte, North Carolina. Eight matches were featured on the card.

zh.s: “大爆炸”是荣耀擂台（ROH）制作、仅在网上提供的职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2010年4月3日在美国北卡罗来纳州夏洛特格雷迪·科尔中心举行，共安排八场比赛。

en.t: Apple Inc. released the first generation iPad, a tablet computer
en.s: The first-generation iPad (; EYE-pad; retrospectively referred to unofficially as the iPad 1 or original iPad) is a tablet computer designed and marketed by Apple as the first device in the iPad lineup of tablet computers. It features an Apple A4 SoC, a 9.7 in (250 mm) touchscreen display, and, on certain variants, the capability of accessing cellular networks.

zh.s: 2010年4月3日，苹果公司在美国推出第一代iPad的无线网络版。

en.s: WrestleMania 27 was the twenty-seventh annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), held on April 3, 2011 at the Georgia Dome in Atlanta, Georgia. The event was the first WrestleMania in the state of Georgia and the second to be held in Southeastern United States, following WrestleMania XXIV. WrestleMania 27 was a joint-promotion event, with performers both from the Raw and SmackDown brands. The event's card consisted of eight matches, including three main matches. In the first, Edge defeated Alberto Del Rio to retain the World Heavyweight Championship in what turned out to be Edge's final televised match before his retirement one week later due to cervical spinal stenosis in his neck.

zh.s: 第二十七届摔角狂热是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2011年4月3日在美国佐治亚州亚特兰大佐治亚巨蛋体育场举行。这是首次在佐治亚州举行，也是继第二十四届后第二次在美国东南部举行。Raw和SmackDown两个品牌共同参赛，总共八场比赛，其中三场为重点大赛。首场重点赛中，艾吉击败阿尔贝托·德尔里奥，卫冕世界重量级冠军。这成为他一周后因颈椎椎管狭窄退役前，最后一场电视转播比赛。

en.s: The 2011 Football League Trophy Final was the 28th final of the domestic football cup competition for teams from Football Leagues One and Two, the Football League Trophy. The final was played at Wembley Stadium in London on 3 April 2011. The match was contested between Brentford and Carlisle United. Carlisle United won the match 1–0. Peter Murphy scored the winning goal, turning in a corner kick in the twelfth minute.

zh.s: 2011年英格兰联赛锦标赛决赛，是这项供英甲、英乙球队参加的国内足球杯赛的第28届决赛，于4月3日在伦敦温布利球场举行。卡莱尔联以1比0击败布伦特福德。彼得·墨菲在第12分钟接角球破门，打入制胜球。

en.s: The 2011 Zürich cantonal elections were held on 3 April 2011, to elect the seven members of the cantonal Executive Council and the 180 members of the Cantonal Council. The Green Party gained a seat on the Executive Council but the FDP-SVP coalition retained a majority of four seats. In the Cantonal Council, the SVP retained a plurality but no alliance reached an overall majority.

zh.s: 2011年4月3日，苏黎世州举行州选举，选出州政府委员会7名成员和州议会180名成员。绿党在州政府委员会中赢得一席，但自由民主党—瑞士人民党联盟保住了四席多数。在州议会中，瑞士人民党仍占相对多数，但没有任何联盟取得绝对多数。

en.s: Early presidential elections were held in Kazakhstan on 3 April 2011, having been originally scheduled for 2012. The elections were called after a plan for holding a referendum to increase president term limits to 2020 was rejected by the Constitutional Council. Nazarbayev was re-elected for a fourth term with 95% of the vote and a 90% turnout, against three nominal candidates.

zh.s: 哈萨克斯坦于2011年4月3日提前举行总统选举，原定选举时间为2012年。此前，延长总统任期至2020年的公投计划被宪法委员会否决，随后举行提前选举。纳扎尔巴耶夫以95%的得票率和90%的投票率击败三名名义上的候选人，连任第四个任期。

en.s: The 2012 Orlando mayoral election was held on Tuesday, April 3, 2012, to elect the mayor of Orlando, Florida. Incumbent mayor Buddy Dyer was elected to a third full term. Municipal elections in Orlando and Orange County are non-partisan. Had no candidate received a majority of the votes in the general election, a runoff would have been held on Tuesday, May 1, 2012, between the two candidates that received the greatest number of votes.

zh.s: 2012年4月3日星期二，美国佛罗里达州奥兰多举行市长选举，现任市长巴迪·戴尔赢得第三个完整任期。奥兰多及奥兰治县的市政选举采用无党派形式。若无人获得过半数选票，原定于5月1日星期二，由得票最高的两人进行决选。

en.s: The 2012 Milwaukee County Executive election took place on April 3, 2012. Incumbent County Executive Chris Abele, who was first elected in a 2011 special election, ran for re-election to a full term. Though State Representative Jeff Stone, who ran against Abele in 2011, and Sheriff David Clarke considered running against Abele, both declined to do so. Abele faced no opponent and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 2012年4月3日，美国密尔沃基县举行县长选举。克里斯·阿贝勒此前在2011年特别选举中首次当选，这次寻求一个完整任期。2011年的对手、州众议员杰夫·斯通，以及治安官戴维·克拉克，都曾考虑参选，但最终均放弃。阿贝勒因此在没有竞争对手的情况下连任。

en.t: 2012 District of Columbia Republican presidential primary
en.s: The 2012 District of Columbia Republican presidential primary was held on April 3, 2012, the same day as the Maryland and Wisconsin Republican primaries.

zh.t: 2012年哥伦比亚特区共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2012年4月3日，美国哥伦比亚特区举行共和党总统初选，与马里兰州和威斯康星州共和党初选在同一天进行。

en.s: The 2012 Milwaukee mayoral election was held on Tuesday, April 3, 2012, to elect the mayor for Milwaukee. Incumbent mayor Tom Barrett was elected to a third term, defeating Edward McDonald.

zh.s: 2012年4月3日（星期二），密尔沃基举行市长选举。现任市长汤姆·巴雷特击败爱德华·麦克唐纳，当选第三个任期。

en.s: On April 3, 2012, Wisconsin held its spring election. The ballot included the Republican presidential nominating contest and various judicial and local elections, including county executive and mayoral races in Milwaukee.
en.n: This records the spring election, separate from the November general election.

zh.s: 2012年4月3日，威斯康星州举行春季选举。选票包括共和党总统候选人初选，以及多项司法职位和地方公职选举，其中有密尔沃基县行政长官和市长选举。
zh.n: 此条记录春季选举，与11月的大选分开。

en.s: Between 1 and 3 April 2013, the northeastern section of Buenos Aires Province, Argentina, experienced several flash floods that claimed the lives of 101 people. Greater La Plata was hardest hit with 91 reported deaths, and Greater Buenos Aires reported 10 deaths. The flooding was the result of extremely heavy rainfall and is said to be the worst flooding in La Plata's history.

zh.s: 2013年4月1日至3日，阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯省东北部发生多起突发洪水，造成101人死亡。大布宜诺斯艾利斯地区报告10人死亡，大拉普拉塔地区受灾最重，报告91人死亡。洪灾由极端强降雨造成，据称是拉普拉塔历史上最严重的洪灾。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: WrestleMania 32 was the thirty-second annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE. It took place on April 3, 2016, at the AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. Twelve matches were contested at the event (including three matches on the pre-show). Four matches were particularly considered to be the marquee attractions.

zh.s: 第三十二届摔角狂热是WWE制作的年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于2016年4月3日在美国得克萨斯州阿灵顿AT&T体育场举行。赛事共进行12场比赛，包括预热节目中的三场。其中四场被视为最重要的看点。

en.s: The 2016 Football League Trophy Final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium on 3 April 2016 to decide the winners of the 2015–16 Football League Trophy, the 32nd edition of the Football League Trophy, a knock-out tournament for the 48 teams in League One and League Two. It was played between Barnsley of League One and Oxford United of League Two, neither of whom had played in a League Trophy final before.

zh.t: 2016年英格兰足球联赛锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2016年英格兰足球联赛锦标赛决赛于2016年4月3日在温布利球场举行，决出2015—16赛季冠军。该赛事是英格兰足球联赛锦标赛第32届，采用淘汰赛制，由英甲和英乙共48支球队参加。决赛由英甲球队巴恩斯利对阵英乙球队牛津联，两队此前都未参加过该项赛事的决赛。

en.s: The Battle of al-Qaryatayn (2016) was a military operation launched by Syrian government forces, supported by Russian airstrikes, to recapture the town of Al-Qaryatayn from the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant. The town lies in a junction that connects the Iraqi border with Palmyra and from Palmyra through to Damascus; it fell to ISIL during the previous Battle of Al-Qaryatayn (August 2015).

zh.s: 卡里亚廷之战（2016年）是叙利亚政府军在俄罗斯空袭支援下发动的一次军事行动，目标是从伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国手中夺回卡里亚廷镇。该镇位于连接伊拉克边境与巴尔米拉、并从巴尔米拉通往大马士革的交通枢纽上；此前，伊斯兰国在2015年8月的第一次卡里亚廷之战中夺取了该镇。

en.s: The 2016 Tajik Supercup was the 7th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajik League and Tajik Cup. The match was contested by 2015 Tajik League and 2015 Tajik Cup champions, Istiklol, and the 2015 Tajik League Runners-up, Khujand. It was held at Stadium Metallurg 1st District in Tursunzoda four days before the first game of the 2016 Tajik League.

zh.s: 2016年4月3日，伊斯提克洛尔队以3比2击败苦盏队，赢得塔吉克斯坦超级杯。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Markham—Thornhill in Ontario, Canada on 3 April 2017 following the resignation of Liberal MP and Minister of Immigration John McCallum, who was appointed to a diplomatic post. The seat was held by the Liberal candidate Mary Ng on a reduced majority. The by-election was scheduled to coincide with four others across the country; Calgary Heritage, Calgary Midnapore, Ottawa—Vanier and Saint-Laurent.

zh.s: 2017年4月3日，加拿大安大略省万锦—康山联邦选区举行补选。自由党议员、移民部长麦家廉获任外交职务后辞职，留下空缺。自由党候选人伍凤仪保住该席，但领先优势缩小。加拿大同日还举行卡尔加里传统区、卡尔加里米德纳波尔、渥太华—瓦尼耶和圣洛朗四场补选。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Calgary Heritage in Alberta, Canada on 3 April 2017 following the resignation of Conservative MP and former Prime Minister of Canada Stephen Harper. The safe seat was held by the Conservative candidate Bob Benzen on an increased majority. The by-election was scheduled to coincide with four others across the country, and was one of two to be held in the city of Calgary; Calgary Midnapore.

zh.t: 2017年卡尔加里传统区联邦补选
zh.s: 2017年4月3日，加拿大阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里传统区举行联邦补选。保守党议员、前总理斯蒂芬·哈珀辞职，留下空缺。保守党候选人鲍勃·本岑保住这一稳固席位，并扩大领先优势。同日全国共举行五场补选，卡尔加里市占两场，另一场在米德纳波尔选区。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Saint-Laurent in Quebec, Canada on 3 April 2017 following the resignation of Liberal MP and Minister of Foreign Affairs Stéphane Dion, who was appointed to a diplomatic post. The seat was held by the Liberal candidate Emmanuella Lambropoulos on a reduced majority. The by-election was scheduled to coincide with four others across the country; Calgary Heritage, Calgary Midnapore, Markham—Thornhill and Ottawa—Vanier.

zh.s: 2017年4月3日，加拿大魁北克省圣洛朗联邦选区举行补选。自由党议员、外交部长斯特凡·迪翁获任外交职务后辞职，留下空缺。自由党候选人埃马纽埃拉·兰布罗普洛斯保住席位，但领先优势缩小。同日还举行卡尔加里传统区、卡尔加里米德纳波尔、万锦—康山及渥太华—瓦尼耶四场补选。

en.s: A by-election was held in the federal riding of Calgary Midnapore in Alberta, Canada on 3 April 2017 following the resignation of Conservative MP and former Minister of National Defence Jason Kenney. The safe seat was held by the Conservative candidate Stephanie Kusie on an increased majority. The by-election was scheduled to coincide with four others across the country, and was one of two to be held in the city of Calgary; Calgary Heritage.

zh.t: 2017年卡尔加里米德纳波尔联邦补选
zh.s: 2017年4月3日，加拿大阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里米德纳波尔联邦选区举行补选。保守党议员、前国防部长杰森·肯尼辞职，留下空缺。保守党候选人斯蒂芬妮·库西保住这一稳固席位，并扩大领先优势。同日全国共举行五场补选，卡尔加里市占两场，另一场在传统区。

en.s: On 3 April 2017, a terrorist attack using an explosive device took place on the Saint Petersburg Metro between Sennaya Ploshchad and Tekhnologichesky Institut stations. Eleven people (including the perpetrator) were initially reported to have died, and five more died later from their injuries, bringing the total to 15. At least 45 others were injured in the incident. The explosive device was contained in a briefcase.

zh.s: 2017年4月3日，圣彼得堡地铁森纳亚广场站与技术学院站之间发生恐怖袭击，袭击者使用了爆炸装置。最初报告称11人死亡（包括袭击者），之后另有5人因伤死亡，死亡总数达到15人；至少45人受伤。爆炸装置放在一个公文包里。

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin Supreme Court election was held on April 3, 2018 to elect a justice to the Wisconsin Supreme Court for a ten-year term. The incumbent justice, Michael Gableman, retired rather than seek another term. Milwaukee County circuit court judge Rebecca Dallet defeated Sauk County circuit court judge Michael Screnock, shifting the ideology of the court towards liberals.

zh.t: 2018年威斯康星州最高法院选举
zh.s: 2018年4月3日，威斯康星州举行最高法院法官选举，选出一名任期十年的法官。现任法官迈克尔·盖布尔曼选择退休，不再竞选。密尔沃基县巡回法院法官丽贝卡·达莱特，击败索克县巡回法院法官迈克尔·斯克雷诺克，使法院的意识形态构成向自由派方向移动。

en.s: On April 3, 2018, at approximately 12:46 p.m. PDT, a shooting occurred at the headquarters of the American video-sharing website YouTube in San Bruno, California. The shooter was identified as 38-year-old Nasim Najafi Aghdam, who entered through an exterior parking garage, approached an outdoor patio, and opened fire with a Smith & Wesson 9 mm semi-automatic pistol. Aghdam wounded three people, one of them critically, before killing herself with her own firearm.

zh.s: 2018年4月3日太平洋夏令时间中午约12时46分，美国视频分享网站YouTube位于加利福尼亚州圣布鲁诺的总部发生枪击。枪手为38岁的纳西姆·纳贾菲·阿格达姆。她从外部停车库进入，走近露天庭院，使用史密斯-韦森9毫米半自动手枪开火。三人受伤，其中一人伤势危重。阿格达姆随后用自己的枪自杀。

en.s: The 2018 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 3, 2018, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw reelection of incumbent mayor Ethan Berkowitz. Since Berkowitz obtained 55% in the initial round, more than the 45% plurality required, no runoff was necessitated.

zh.s: 2018年4月3日，阿拉斯加州安克雷奇举行市长选举。现任市长伊桑·伯科维茨连任。伯科维茨在首轮获得55%的选票，超过避免第二轮所需的45%相对多数，因此无需举行第二轮投票。

en.s: On April 3, 2018, Wisconsin held its spring election. Voters decided a contested Wisconsin Supreme Court race, a state constitutional amendment referendum and various other nonpartisan local and judicial elections.
en.n: This records the spring election, separate from the November general election.

zh.s: 2018年4月3日，威斯康星州举行春季选举。选民投票决定州最高法院法官人选、州宪法修正案公投，以及其他多项不分党派的地方公职和司法职位选举。
zh.n: 此条记录春季选举，与11月的大选分开。

en.s: The Copa Nuevos Valores (Spanish for "New Values Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament promoted by the Mexican lucha libre promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) held between April 3 and April 17, 2018, at Arena México. The tournament was held to give prominence to 16 younger, lower ranked wrestlers who worked for CMLL at the time.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 新秀杯（西班牙语：Copa Nuevos Valores，意为“新秀杯”）是墨西哥自由式摔角推广方世界摔角理事会（CMLL）主办的一项职业摔角锦标赛，于2018年4月3日至17日在墨西哥竞技场举行。赛事旨在让当时效力于CMLL的16名年轻、排名较低的摔角手获得更多关注。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是源信息框所列赛事日期。

en.s: On April 3, 2020, members of the La Línea faction of the Juárez Cartel led by El 32 ambushed members of Gente Nueva del Jaguar y sus Lobos, a faction of the Sinaloa Cartel led by El Jaguar, near Ciudad Madera, Chihuahua, Mexico. Nineteen people were killed in the ambush, and one was injured.

zh.s: 2020年4月3日，墨西哥华雷斯贩毒集团“拉利内亚”派系的成员，在绰号“32号”的头目带领下，于奇瓦瓦州马德拉城附近，伏击锡那罗亚贩毒集团“美洲豹与狼群新人帮”派系。后者由绰号“美洲豹”的头目领导。伏击造成19人死亡、一人受伤。

en.s: The 2021 Sukma–Bijapur attack was an ambush carried out by the Naxalite-Maoist militants from the Communist Party of India (Maoist) against Indian security forces on 3 April 2021 at Sukma-Bijapur border near Jonaguda village which falls under Jagargunda police station area in Sukma district of Chhattisgarh, the ensuing gunfight lead to the killing of 22 security personnel as well as 20 Naxalites.

zh.s: 2021年4月3日，印度共产党（毛主义）的纳萨尔派武装，在恰蒂斯加尔邦苏克马县贾加尔贡达警察辖区、乔纳古达村附近的苏克马—比贾布尔边界，伏击印度安全部队。随后的交火造成22名安全人员及20名纳萨尔派武装人员死亡。

en.s: The 2020 Copa del Rey final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2019–20 Copa del Rey, the 118th edition of Spain's primary football cup (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was played at the Estadio de La Cartuja in Seville between Athletic Bilbao and Real Sociedad, the first Basque derby final.

zh.s: 这场比赛决出2019—20赛季西班牙国王杯冠军，是该项赛事第118届（其中包括两次出现不同赛事版本的赛季）。决赛在塞维利亚的拉卡图哈体育场举行，由毕尔巴鄂竞技对阵皇家社会；这是国王杯决赛首次上演巴斯克德比。
zh.n: 2019—20赛季的决赛因疫情推迟，实际于2021年4月3日举行。

en.s: The 2021 Tajik Supercup was the 12th Tajik Supercup, an annual Tajik football match played between the winners of the previous season's Tajikistan Higher League and Tajikistan Cup. The match was contested by 2020 League champions Istiklol, and the 2020 Cup champions Ravshan. It was held at the Central Stadium in Hisor on 3 April.

zh.s: 2021年塔吉克斯坦超级杯是第12届该项赛事，由上赛季塔吉克斯坦超级联赛冠军伊斯蒂克洛尔队对阵2020年塔吉克斯坦杯冠军拉夫尚队。比赛于4月3日在希索尔中央体育场举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Serbia on 3 April 2022 to elect both the president of Serbia and members of the National Assembly. Initially, parliamentary elections were scheduled to be held in 2024; however, in October 2020 president Aleksandar Vučić said that snap parliamentary elections would be held in or before April 2022. In addition to the general elections, local elections were held simultaneously in 12 municipalities and 2 cities, including Belgrade, the capital of Serbia.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚于2022年4月3日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。议会选举原定于2024年举行，但总统亚历山大·武契奇在2020年10月表示，将于2022年4月或之前提前选举。此外，12个市镇和两座城市也同步举行地方选举，包括首都贝尔格莱德。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 3 April 2022 to elect the National Assembly, coinciding with a referendum. Hungary's incumbent prime minister Viktor Orbán won re-election to a fourth term. Addressing his supporters after the partial results showed Fidesz–KDNP leading by a wide margin, Orbán said: "We won a victory so big that you can see it from the moon, and you can certainly see it from Brussels."

zh.s: 匈牙利于2022年4月3日举行国民议会选举，并同期举行公投。现任总理维克托·欧尔班赢得第四个任期。部分结果显示青民盟与基督教民主人民党联盟大幅领先后，欧尔班向支持者说：“这场胜利大得从月球都能看见，从布鲁塞尔当然更看得见。”

en.s: The 2022 EFL Trophy Final (known for sponsorship reasons as the 2022 Papa Johns Trophy) was a football match played at Wembley Stadium, London, on 3 April 2022. It decided the winners of the 2021–22 EFL Trophy, the 38th edition of the competition, a knock-out tournament for the 48 teams in League One and League Two and 16 category one academy sides.

zh.s: 2022年英格兰联赛锦标赛决赛，因冠名赞助又称“2022年棒约翰杯决赛”，于4月3日在伦敦温布利球场举行，决定2021—2022赛季冠军。这是第38届赛事，采用淘汰赛制，参赛者包括英甲和英乙的48支球队，以及16支一级青训梯队。

loc: 美国得克萨斯州阿灵顿

en.s: WrestleMania 38 was a 2022 two-part professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 38th annual WrestleMania and took place as a two-night event on Saturday, April 2, and Sunday, April 3, 2022, at the AT&T Stadium in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex city of Arlington, Texas.

zh.s: 第三十八届摔角狂热是WWE为主要选手品牌Raw和SmackDown制作的年度职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事。2022年赛事分两晚举行，分别为4月2日星期六和4月3日星期日，场地是美国得克萨斯州达拉斯—沃思堡都会区阿灵顿的AT&T体育场。

en.s: Local elections in Serbia were held on 3 April 2022 in the municipalities of Aranđelovac, Bajina Bašta, Belgrade, Bor, Doljevac, Kladovo, Knjaževac, Kula, Lučani, Majdanpek, Medveđa, Sečanj, Sevojno (a municipality in the city of Užice), and Smederevska Palanka. Alongside the local elections, national-level general elections were held simultaneously on the same day. Seven ballot lists appeared in the election in Aranđelovac, while nine ballot lists appeared in Bajina Bašta.

zh.s: 2022年4月3日，塞尔维亚的阿兰杰洛瓦茨、巴伊纳巴什塔、贝尔格莱德、博尔、多列瓦茨、克拉多沃、克尼亚热瓦茨、库拉、卢查尼、马伊丹佩克、梅德韦贾、塞查尼、塞沃伊诺，以及斯梅代雷夫斯卡帕兰卡举行地方选举。其中塞沃伊诺是乌日策市内的一个自治市。同一天，全国也举行总统和议会大选。阿兰杰洛瓦茨共有七份候选名单参选，巴伊纳巴什塔则有九份。

en.s: The 2022 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the SPFL Trust Trophy final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match that took place on 3 April 2022 between Raith Rovers and Queen of the South. It was the 29th final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the now defunct Scottish Football League, and the seventh since the SPFL was formed.

zh.s: 2022年苏格兰挑战杯决赛因赞助原因又称SPFL信托奖杯决赛，于2022年4月3日举行，由雷斯流浪者对阵南方女王。这是苏格兰挑战杯第29届决赛。该赛事于1990年首次举办，以纪念如今已解散的苏格兰足球联赛成立100周年；这是苏格兰职业足球联赛（SPFL）成立后的第七届赛事。

en.s: The 2023 Prince Edward Island general election was held to elect the members of the 67th General Assembly of Prince Edward Island on 3 April 2023. The election normally required by 2 October under Prince Edward Island's fixed election date legislation was called early by Premier Dennis King at his nomination meeting on 6 March.

zh.s: 2023年4月3日，爱德华王子岛举行大选，选出第67届省议会成员。根据该省固定选举日期法，选举原本最迟应于10月2日举行，但省长丹尼斯·金在3月6日的提名大会上宣布提前选举。

en.s: The 2023 Friuli-Venezia Giulia regional election took place from 2 to 3 April 2023. The election took place concurrently with the municipal election in 19 comuni of the Region.

zh.s: 2023年弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚大区选举于2023年4月2日至3日举行。选举与该大区19个市镇的市政选举同期进行。

en.s: The PFL 1 mixed martial arts event for the 2025 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on April 3, 2025, at the Universal Studios Florida in Orlando, Florida, United States. This event marked the quarterfinal of the single-elimination tournament format in the Welterweight and Featherweight divisions.

zh.s: 2025赛季职业格斗联盟PFL 1综合格斗赛事，于4月3日在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多环球影城举行。本场进行次中量级和羽量级单败淘汰赛的四分之一决赛。
